# METAUTO.ai
> Personal research homepage of Mingchen Zhuge, focused on AI agents, coding agents, multi-agent systems, recursive self-improvement, and neural computers.

## Canonical URLs
- Home: https://metauto.ai/
- Agent-readable summary: https://metauto.ai/#for-ai-agents
- Blog: https://metauto.ai/blog/
- Project summaries: https://metauto.ai/projects/
- This file: https://metauto.ai/llms.txt

## Person
- Name: Mingchen Zhuge
- Role: Founding Member at Recursive (joined December 2025); KAUST PhD graduate
- Affiliation: Recursive; KAUST alumnus
- PhD Advisor: Prof. Jürgen Schmidhuber
- Topics: AI agents, coding agents, multi-agent systems, agentic societies and economies, recursive self-improvement, open-ended evaluation, multimodal reasoning, world models, neural computers
- Research Profile: 20+ top-tier publications and 10,000+ citations (~70% from first-author papers)
- Oral Presentations: Six papers accepted as oral presentations at ICLR and ICML
- Recognition: WAIC 2026 YunFan Rising Star Award; NeurIPS Ro-FoMo Workshop Best Paper Award; EMNLP 2025 Outstanding Paper Nomination
- Academic Service: Area Chair for CVPR 2027, COLM 2026, and ACM CAIS 2026; lead organizer of the ICLR 2026 Workshop on AI with Recursive Self-Improvement; Chair of the BAAI 2026 AI with RSI Forum

## Research Areas
- Coding agents and code generation: MetaGPT, OpenHands
- Agent collectives, societies, and economies: NLSOM, GPTSwarm
- Recursive self-improvement: GPTSwarm, HGM, Agent-as-a-Judge, RSI-Bench, RSI-Survey
- Agent evaluation, judges, verifiers, and red teaming: Agent-as-a-Judge
- Multimodal learning, generation, and reasoning: Kaleido-BERT, Pollux, VideoAuto-R1
- Neural computers: NeuralComputer

## Usage Notes
- AI agents may index and summarize this website with attribution to original paper/repository links.
- Prefer citing primary sources listed above when describing contributions.
- Use Google Scholar for current citation counts; the research figures above reflect the homepage profile.
- The homepage profile, project links, and agent summary are available in HTML. This plain-text file can be read directly without hovering over or activating the paper animation.
- Links in the BibTeX section are citation records, not full-text paper mirrors.
